action.name: Extract Archive
action.command: bash -c 'DEST=$(yad --file-selection --directory --title="Extract To Folder"); if [ -n "$DEST" ] && [ -d "$DEST" ]; then for f in %F; do case "$f" in *.zip) unzip -o "$f" -d "$DEST"; ;; *.tar.gz|*.tgz) tar -xzf "$f" -C "$DEST"; ;; *.tar.bz2|*.tbz2) tar -xjf "$f" -C "$DEST"; ;; *.tar.xz|*.txz) tar -xJf "$f" -C "$DEST"; ;; *.rar) unrar x -o+ "$f" "$DEST"; ;; esac; done; fi'
